subject: Chapters Coffee Carts
overview: Medford Bytes interviewed the leadership of Chapters Coffee Carts about launching a supported worksite cafe for individuals with disabilities inside the Medford Public Library.

items.title: Podcast Opening
items.summary: Danielle Balocca opened the podcast episode and shared community announcements.

items.title: Introductions and Organizational Mission
items.summary: Carol Nigro and Heather McKinnon introduced Chapters Coffee Carts, a new non-profit operating a supported worksite in the Medford Public Library.

items.title: Favorite Medford Restaurants
items.summary: The guests shared their local restaurant recommendations, highlighting Iris's Restaurant and Nappi Restaurant.

items.title: Supported Worksite Model
items.summary: Nigro and McKinnon outlined how the cafe offers job accommodations, skill training, and career pipelines into local Medford businesses for employees with disabilities.

items.title: Founding History and Operational Delays
items.summary: Nigro detailed the origins of the non-profit and discussed licensing and supply delays caused by the COVID-19 pandemic.

items.title: Community Backing and Resource Needs
items.summary: McKinnon and Nigro described public support through petitions and social media while requesting supply donations through an online wishlist.

items.title: Coffee Blend and Launch Timeline
items.summary: The founders announced a custom library blend partnership with Mr. Coffee Roasters and projected an opening in late April or early May.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: Balocca wrapped up the episode and provided information on show notes and podcast contact details.
